entities.name: Query protein (341 aa)
observations: 341-aa sequence; estimated mass 36,820 Da, theoretical pI 4.87, GRAVY −0.095, instability index 35.30; sequence-derived estimates.

Strong match to reviewed Bacillus subtilis aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase Q04797: 65.3% identity, 99.7% query coverage, E=7.41e−156; function is inferred by homology, not directly experimentally established for query.
Likely EC 1.2.1.11 enzyme: NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of 4-phospho-L-aspartate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde; implicated in lysine, methionine, threonine biosynthesis.
Reviewed homologs annotate homodimeric assembly and cytosolic localization; transfer to query remains inference.
